test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of the art of puppetry?

options.text: It is a good therapy for physically challenged people.
It is entertaining for people of all ages.
A puppeteer is required to manipulate the puppets.
Messages can be propagated in a realistic manner.

solution:
​The correct answer is "**A puppeteer is required to manipulate the puppets**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **theme **of the given comprehension is about **puppetry **and how it evolved as an art form, It can be a medium of communication as well as a source of entertainment for young and old alike.
 
• In the **last **paragraph of comprehension. it is mentioned that the art of puppetry can have benefits such as therapy for the physically challenged, entertainment for old and young alike, and the idea of puppetry as a communicative form.

**Thus the correct answer is option 3**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** 

 
• All the other options about the benefits of puppetry are found in the last paragraph except for **option 3.**
